items.title: Bank of America (BAC) Renews Long Term Card Tie Up With a Travel Partner
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) and Allegiant Travel Company extended their co-branded credit card partnership under a new long-term agreement. The renewed pact keeps Allegiant’s Allways Rewards credit card on the Bank of America platform with continued loyalty program integration. The extension supports Bank of America’s focus on recurring non-interest income streams tied to travel and everyday spending.
